I had a very strong experience on mushrooms in my early twenties that I still think about. I took them with my then-girlfriend in her parents' garden while they were on holiday. About an hour in, I lay on the lawn and looked up at the sky, and the sky opened. I mean it literally looked like it was splitting apart, and behind it was a huge, unimaginably old darkness. I felt that something was looking at me from that darkness, and that it had always been looking at me, my whole life, and that it was neither good nor evil, just completely indifferent. Under that gaze I felt myself shrink to nothing. My memories, my plans, my love for my girlfriend, all of it became tiny and pointless, like dust.

I tried to get up and go inside, but the house seemed impossibly far away, and the garden kept stretching. My girlfriend was sitting next to me and I couldn't make her understand. She kept saying 'look at the flowers', and the flowers were beautiful, but I knew they were a thin coating over the darkness. I started crying and couldn't stop. I clung to the grass because I felt that if I let go, I would fall upwards into the sky and disappear.

It lasted for maybe three or four hours. In the evening it faded, and we went inside and watched a cartoon, which was the only thing I could handle. The colours of the cartoon were comforting, like a children's room after a nightmare. But that night, when I lay in bed and closed my eyes, I could still feel the darkness behind the ceiling.

Ich habe mit meiner besten Freundin LSD genommen, und sie hat einen sehr schlechten Trip bekommen. Sie hat geschrien, sich die Haare ausgerissen und wollte aus dem Fenster im vierten Stock steigen. Ich habe sie festgehalten und war selbst mitten im Trip. Ihr Gesicht hat sich ständig verändert, und ich hatte panische Angst, dass sie springt oder dass ich sie nicht halten kann. Ich habe mit einer Hand den Notruf gewählt. Die Sanitäter und die Polizei kamen, und sie wurde mitgenommen. Ich saß danach allein in der Wohnung und konnte nicht aufhören zu zittern.

Mushrooms with friends, it was supposed to be a mellow afternoon. I ended up believing I'd been dead for years and that my friends were ghosts pretending to be alive to keep me company. It was strangely sad more than scary, then terrifying when I realised I didn't know how to 'wake up'. Lasted maybe 3 hours.

Ich habe einige Jahre lang regelmäßig Ayahuasca in einer Gruppe in Deutschland getrunken und dachte, ich kenne die Medizin gut. Bei einer Zeremonie im letzten Winter ist etwas anders gewesen. Schon kurz nach dem Trinken bekam ich starkes Herzrasen und das Gefühl, dass mein Körper brennt. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass etwas Fremdes in mich eindringt, eine Art Schatten, der sich in meinem Brustkorb festsetzt. Ich habe versucht, ihn auszuspucken, mich übergeben, gebetet. Nichts half. Der Schatten wurde größer, bis ich das Gefühl hatte, dass er mich vollständig ausfüllt und dass ich nicht mehr ich selbst bin, sondern nur noch dieser Schatten. Ich hörte eine Stimme, die nicht meine war, aus meinem eigenen Mund kommen. Die anderen Teilnehmer haben gesungen, und der Gesang wurde für mich zu einem Kampf gegen mich, als wollten sie den Schatten und mich gleich mit vertreiben. Die Leiterin hat lange bei mir gesessen und Rauch über mich geblasen. Irgendwann im Morgengrauen hat es nachgelassen. Ich war völlig erschöpft und hatte das Gefühl, dass der Schatten nicht ganz weg ist.

I'd been depressed for a long time and decided to try LSD on my own, hoping for something like a reset. I took two tabs in my flat. Within an hour, everything I disliked about myself was projected onto the walls like a slideshow. My ugliness, my failures, the time I'd been cruel to my little sister, the job I got fired from. A voice, which I recognised as my own but much harsher, commented on every image. You're pathetic. Nobody wants you. You should have never been born. I tried to turn on music, but every song had lyrics that seemed to agree with the voice.

I went into the bathroom and looked in the mirror, which was a terrible mistake. My face aged and rotted in front of me. Then it became my father's face, who left when I was five. I punched the mirror and cut my hand. There was blood in the sink, and on LSD the blood was the most vivid red I've ever seen, almost glowing. I sat on the bathroom floor and watched it drip and thought, very calmly, that it would be easier to let it all end.

I didn't. I don't know why. Maybe because a small part of me knew it was the drug. I wrapped my hand in a towel, crawled to my bed and lay there for ten hours under the covers, with the slideshow continuing on the inside of my eyelids. In the morning I went to A&E for stitches and told them I'd fallen.

Took acid at a forest rave. Got separated from friends and wandered into a dark part of the forest where some guys were doing something that looked like an animal sacrifice. In hindsight it was probably a barbecue, but I was sure I'd stumbled into a cult and that they'd seen me. I ran and hid in a ditch until dawn.

Ich habe zum ersten Mal Psilocybin genommen, in einer legalen Sitzung in den Niederlanden. Die Begleiterin war freundlich, die Umgebung schön. Trotzdem hatte ich eine sehr schwierige Erfahrung. Ich habe gespürt, wie ich mich selbst verliere, und hatte das Gefühl, verrückt zu werden. Ich habe mich an der Hand der Begleiterin festgehalten, bis es vorbei war. Am Ende hatte ich einen kurzen Moment großer Klarheit.

I was a 'trip sitter' for a group of friends at a cabin, the only sober one. During the night one of them, who had taken LSD and mushrooms, became completely psychotic. He thought he was a prophet and that he had to 'baptise' us all in the freezing lake. He grabbed another friend and dragged him to the water. I had to physically fight him to stop him from holding our friend under. I'm not a fighter. I was punched in the face and my nose bled. Eventually I got our friend free, and the guy ran into the forest. We called the police, who found him two hours later, hypothermic and still raving. I wasn't on anything, but I've included this because it's the most traumatic experience I've had involving psychedelics, and because I was 'responsible' for everyone that night.
LSD, Freund zu laut, Nachbarn klingeln, ich bin in Panik geraten und habe mich im Schrank versteckt.

I'm a 42-year-old woman, mother of three, and I had my first ever psychedelic experience at a friend's birthday weekend. Several of the women there had done mushrooms before and they convinced me to try. I'd been feeling burned out and thought it might do me good.

I took what they gave me, which they said was a 'gentle dose'. I don't know how much it was. For the first hour I felt silly and laughed a lot. Then my body felt very heavy and I lay down on a bed upstairs. And then I wasn't on the bed anymore. I was in a place without walls, completely dark, with a sound like a heartbeat everywhere. I realised I was in a womb. Then I realised it was my mother's womb, and that I could feel what she was feeling while she was pregnant with me, which was fear and sadness and a deep wish that I didn't exist. I don't know if that's true, my mother has never talked about her pregnancy, but in that moment it was the most real thing I'd ever felt.

I started sobbing and couldn't stop. One of my friends came up and sat with me. She tried to hold my hand but I couldn't bear to be touched. I felt I'd been unwanted from the very beginning, and that everything in my life, my need to please, my exhaustion, my inability to rest, came from trying to earn the right to exist.

Then it got worse. I thought of my own children and became terrified that they feel the same way about me, that I've passed this on to them. I saw their faces, sad and lonely. I felt like the worst mother in the world and the worst daughter, a chain of unwanted children going back forever.

It took about five hours to come down. My friends were kind but they were also having their own experiences, and I spent most of the time alone in that room. The next day we all had brunch and they talked about how amazing it was. I smiled and nodded.
Smoked DMT. Broke through into a place where everything was laughing at me. Not with me, at me. I felt like the universe was a joke and I was the punchline. Came back crying.

Ich war mit Freunden auf einem Festival und wir hatten Pilze genommen. Plötzlich hat eine Freundin angefangen zu krampfen. Ich wusste nicht, ob das echt ist oder ob ich halluziniere. Die Sanitäter kamen, und ich bin mit ins Zelt der Sanitäter gegangen. Sie hatte, wie sich herausstellte, einen epileptischen Anfall, von dem sie selbst nichts wusste. Ich saß stundenlang neben ihr, während sie bewusstlos war, und hatte das Gefühl, dass sie stirbt und dass es meine Schuld ist, weil ich die Pilze besorgt hatte. Die Lichter und Geräusche im Zelt waren für mich eine Hölle.
